title: Rega P1 / Rega Carbon — 1 kHz Reference Check

harmonic_reliability.quality_note: Steady during recording. Suitable for setup guidance.

interpretation.summary: At the AudioReview laboratory, Groove Scope guided an azimuth adjustment that narrowed the Rega Carbon’s directional crosstalk gap from 10.27 dB to 1.16 dB and brought average separation to 31.8 dB. In a separate Groove Scope Studio tracking trial, the Rega P1 and Carbon reached 80 µm at 2.5 g after stopping at 60 µm at 2.0 g.
interpretation.alignment_context: The cartridge looked aligned at the start of the session. Azimuth adjustment reduced right-to-left leakage by 7.7 dB while left-to-right leakage rose by 1.3 dB. Average separation improved by 3.2 dB. Signal-level balance moved from +0.77 dB to +1.04 dB left minus right.
interpretation.tracking_context: The reported tracking level rose by 20 µm between the two trial settings. The tracking force for the 1 kHz reference capture was not recorded.
interpretation.rotation_context: Both speed fingerprints show a recurring trough near the middle of the displayed angular scale over eight revolutions. The test record’s contribution and the mechanical cause of the variation were not established.

session_observations.source: Measurer account supplied with publication request
session_observations.acknowledgement: Mauro Neri, director of AudioReview, made the laboratory session possible.

provenance.data_entry_method: Numerical results were transcribed from the original PDF report and checked against its rendered page. Reported differences preserve source precision. The starting readings and tracking trial come from the measurer’s session account.
provenance.raw_audio_note: No raw test-record audio is included.
provenance.setup_metadata_source: The PDF title identifies the Rega P1, Rega Carbon and ART. The report identifies the input as USB Audio CODEC. The measurer supplied the laboratory location and the azimuth and tracking observations.
known_limitations: The tonearm, ART preamp model and exact USB capture-device model were not recorded.

The reference capture’s tracking force, physical azimuth angle, anti-skate, loading, alignment geometry, test-record identity and track, capture settings, repeat count and software versions were not recorded.
The initial readings and tracking trials are measurer-reported. No initial 1 kHz report or tracking trace was supplied. The tracking-test frequency and pass criterion were not recorded.
The results describe the playback chain as captured. The individual contributions of the cartridge, tonearm, turntable, test record and electronics were not isolated.
provenance.fingerprint_channel_assignment: Channel assignments follow the supplied filenames. Both channels show eight rotations. The angular reference between captures is unspecified.
provenance.photo_treatment: The archived source is a full-resolution 4032 × 3024 JPEG from the supplied HEIC with embedded metadata stripped. ImageGen previewed cosmetic cleanup and neutral lighting. The published retouch applies a tonal grade to the original photograph and preserves the geometry of the cartridge, stylus and mounting hardware.
